plugins.name: project-dashboard
plugins.description: Set up and run a project's status dashboard - scaffold a _project-dashboard/ folder, then refresh it (numbers, narrative, deck, audio brief) by following that project's own AGENTS.md playbook. Works across any project that follows the pattern.

plugins.name: project-workflow
plugins.description: Run a software project end-to-end: stand up and operate a GitHub Project (v2) board (setup, weekly triage, status reporting, dependency sequencing), turn intent into conformant issues and source-grounded plans, keep sessions continuous via a durable handoff, and produce project docs — CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md, value-and-proof READMEs, diagrams, and status comms. Harness-agnostic; the process SOPs live in docs/sops/.

plugins.name: python-standards
plugins.description: Enforces modern Python standards: uv for packages, ty for type checking, ruff for linting/formatting. Auto-detects Python projects, auto-formats on save, validates before session end.
